cohort: The study included 277 women diagnosed with gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) who received care at a university hospital in Cracow, Poland.
finding: The study found no significant differences in clinical outcomes for mothers and newborns between those using Flash Glucose Monitoring (FGM) versus Self-Blood Glucose Monitoring (SBGM) for gestational diabetes management.
mod_finding: There was no significant difference in the rate of caesarean sections between the FGM and SBGM groups.
birth_weight: Mean birth weight was 3243 g (SBGM group) and 3331 g (FGM group).
gest_age: Median gestational age at delivery was 38 weeks (SBGM group) and 39 weeks (FGM group).
